data.name: Lethal Grace
data.detailed_description:
How do you imagine the world of the future?

In Lethal Grace, large corporations rule the world. Androids have long been part of society, and it is impossible to distinguish them from humans—except for their artificial eyes.

You play as Grace, an android girl and hired assassin working for one of the most influential corporations. Your task is to find and eliminate targets.

A dynamic first-person shooter.

Key features:

  • Use your abilities: run on walls, slow down time, use a shield, and more.

  • The environment is destructible.

  • Lively and intense shootouts.

  • An exciting and dramatic storyline.
